name: Special Workspaces
description: Requires drpezzer.roadie for full effect. Isolated special-workspace state and UI on the workspace bar: per-button dot/pill indicators, dimmed highlight, blocked navigation while isolated. Dock auto-hide/fullscreen awareness of special-workspace windows is now provided by drpezzer.roadie directly. Pairs with positive.workspace-app-indicator for the focused-app badge.
author: POSiTiiiV
permissions: Reads /tmp/ambxst_special_ws.txt to track the active isolated special workspace
Blocks workspace navigation and dims the active-workspace highlight while a special workspace is open
